title: $\mathfrak{d}=ω_1$ implies $\mathfrak{a}=ω_1$
summary: We prove in ZFC that $\mathfrak d=ω_1$ implies $\mathfrak a=ω_1$, settling a question of Roitman from the 1970s. Here $\mathfrak d$ is the least size of a family that eventually dominates every function in $ω^ω$, and $\mathfrak a$ is the least size of an infinite maximal almost disjoint (MAD) family of infinite subsets of $ω$. Consequently, $\mathfrak a\leq\mathfrak d$ whenever the continuum $\mathfrak c=2^{\aleph_0}$ is at most $ω_2$.
